title: AL-Go for Github April Office Hour

chapters.title: AL-Go v7.0 release and page scripting visualizer

features.name: Page scripting visualizer
features.description: A new feature that visualizes test results in CI/CD runs, showing failing, passing, and skipped tests along with overall run time.
features.status_evidence_quote: and also the new page scripting visualizer uh in preview
caveats: Only visualizing part is new, base scripting already existed

features.name: Deploy to sandbox from pull request
features.description: Support for deploying to sandbox environments from a pull request, which was previously in preview and is now included in v7.0.
features.status_evidence_quote: we did ship version 7.0 and that included the support for deploying to sandbox environments from a pool request

features.name: Runtime package generation and integration
features.description: Feature to generate runtime packages and integrate them with Nougat, allowing apps to be built for different targets. Expected to be finalized before October 1st.
caveats: Depends on modern dev team compiler
May be optimized later to save runner time

features.name: Build modes with preprocessor symbols
features.description: Latest AL-Go edition allows building apps for different targets using build modes and preprocessor symbols, enabling single source for multiple app source and on-prem variants.

features.name: BC container helper v6.1 breaking changes
features.description: BC container helper versions before 6.1 will have broken major functionalities after May 1st due to security-related work.
features.status_evidence_quote: all BC container helper versions before version 6.1 might not work after May 1st. At least like major functionalities will be broken
caveats: Does not affect repositories using AL-Go for GitHub

features.name: BC Container Helper retirement
features.description: BC Container Helper is slated for retirement in the next two to three years and will be replaced by a PowerShell gallery successor with new AL-Go modules for DevOps tasks.
caveats: Some functionality gaps expected
UseTraffic option support uncertain
Migration timeline is two to three years

features.name: AL-Go PowerShell module for local development
features.description: A new slim PowerShell module will be created for local development tasks like spinning up containers, replacing parts of BC Container Helper. This will be published in the PowerShell gallery and contain approximately five to ten commands.
caveats: Exact command count not yet determined
Partner input still being gathered
Details not finalized

features.name: AL-Go modules within AL-Go shipping
features.description: DevOps-related modules and functionality will be shipped directly within AL-Go rather than on the PowerShell gallery, consolidating tooling for CI/CD tasks.
caveats: Architecture and module boundaries still being defined

features.name: GitHub Discussions for AL-Go
features.description: AL-Go is moving from GitHub Issues to GitHub Discussions for community engagement, allowing users to ask questions, suggest ideas, and vote on features. This provides a better forum for community discussions.
caveats: Recently launched
Still building community participation

features.name: Community-driven feature voting
features.description: Users can vote on ideas in AL-Go Discussions, and the most voted ideas will be prioritized for implementation and moved from discussions to the project backlog.
caveats: No guaranteed implementation
Voting-based prioritization, not promise-based

features.name: NG Get integration
features.description: NG Get integration is mentioned as something the team is working on based on community voting and ideas.
caveats: In development
Community voting driving priority

features.name: Code coverage support
features.description: Code coverage functionality is being considered as a potential feature for AL-Go based on community interest.
caveats: Uncertain timeline
Dependent on community voting and team capacity

features.name: AL-Go documentation on branching
features.description: AL-Go has suggestions and documentation related to branching strategies for development workflows.

features.name: GitHub branch update requirement for pull requests
features.description: GitHub feature that allows requiring branches to be up to date before merging. When enabled, an update branch action appears on pull requests that pulls the target branch into the PR branch automatically, with conflicts resolved in the UI.
caveats: Feature not available in Azure DevOps

features.name: Azure DevOps repository support in AL-Go
features.description: AL-Go supports some repositories in Azure DevOps, though certain features like branch update requirements for pull requests are not available.
caveats: Some GitHub features not available in Azure DevOps
No branch update requirement feature found
